_meta.description: Verified product records for the three user-supplied Amazon links. Values are only what was observed on the cited official Amazon product page. Blank or withheld fields are listed in flags.json.
_meta.method: Each user link was resolved to its Amazon product page (the redirect target), then the listing's title, byline, breadcrumb, specification table and 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' list were read. Prices and star ratings were read but are NOT published on the site (see flags F-02).

reverification.result: Every published field was read again from the official Amazon product page and matched: listing title, brand byline, store link, category breadcrumb, and the full specification table (special features, dimensions, colour, capacity, material) for all three products, plus the three also-viewed carousels. The special-feature row is new and is now published. This closes the gap recorded as F-18, which the previous session had left open, and adds F-26 for P2's two different cooking function counts.
